Before broad TutorChat rollout for an Enterprise customer, NovaLearn should:

- **Complete SSO and permission audits first.** Enterprise TutorChat adoption is currently low because several enterprise accounts are running limited pilots and have not deployed to the broader employee base pending SSO and permission audits [NL-030#NL-030-S03].
- **Ensure Enterprise SSO is configured with a supported provider.** SSO is generally available for Enterprise and supports Okta, Microsoft Azure AD, Ping Identity, and OneLogin via SAML 2.0 and OIDC [NL-002#NL-002-S11]. TutorChat relies on mapping the user’s AD/Okta token to document folder permissions and filtering retrieval by role permissions [NL-002#NL-002-S03].
- **Resolve permission-mapping friction.** Enterprise and mid-market customers report onboarding delays from the complexity of mapping nested permissions from SharePoint, local file servers, and shared drives to NovaLearn workspaces [NL-011#NL-011-S01].
- **Set correct expectations about Microsoft Teams.** The Teams integration is not generally available; it is in design and planning for Q4 2026, with a restricted pilot starting October 2026 [NL-014#NL-014-S07]. Enterprise clients are requesting Teams, and several renewals depend on it [NL-011#NL-011-S01]. Currently only the Slack connector is available as a limited pilot for selected accounts [NL-002#NL-002-S11].
- **Run a high-impact pilot before broad rollout.** The recommended approach for mid-market and enterprise clients is to run pilots with 100–300 users in high-impact departments to justify the onboarding investment [NL-023#NL-023-S03]. Enterprise onboarding takes a median of 8.7 weeks due to permission and security complexities [NL-016#NL-016-S03].
- **Account for API constraints in custom integrations.** The Enterprise REST API uses OAuth 2.0 client credentials with 60-minute token rotation, enforces a rate limit of 150 requests per minute per workspace, and requires backoff or caching strategies for large workloads [NL-002#NL-002-S11].
